## 3. Major Engineering Projects (20 Production Deployments)

### 3.1 AI Engineering Systems
1. **Multi-Agent AI System** (`hamid220-kamal/Multi-Agent-AI-System`): Custom `asyncio` state-machine orchestration with Pydantic v2 validation, ChromaDB memory layer, and SSE streaming with Human-In-The-Loop approval gates.
2. **End-to-End MLOps & LLMOps Pipeline** (`hamid220-kamal/End-to-End-MLOps---LLMOps-Pipeline`): Full lifecycle pipeline with automated hallucination regression gates, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, Arize Phoenix observability, and multi-stage Docker CI/CD.
3. **Advanced Production RAG** (`hamid220-kamal/Advanced-production-RAG`): Hybrid dense + sparse (BM25) vector retrieval with cross-encoder neural reranking, query decomposition, and citation grounding.
4. **Fine-Tuning & Model Optimization Pipeline** (`hamid220-kamal/Fine-Tuning---Model-Optimization-Pipeline`): PEFT/LoRA fine-tuning with 4-bit/8-bit GGUF quantization for memory-mapped low-RAM CPU inference via `llama-cpp-python`.
5. **AI Traffic Management System** (`hamid220-kamal/AI-traffic-management-system`): Urban vehicle density optimization using fine-tuned YOLOv8 computer vision and FastAPI WebSocket streaming. Live at https://ai-traffic-management-system-henna.vercel.app.
6. **OverR1de Cybersecurity** (`hamid220-kamal/OverR1de`): Offensive security laboratory featuring automated Python penetration testing tools, multi-threaded scanners, and exploit verification suites.
7. **End-to-End AI Capstone** (`hamid220-kamal/end-to-end-ai-capstone`): Modular intelligence hub with facial biometrics, NLP dialog parsing, and Flask glassmorphism interface.
8. **Heart Disease Prediction** (`hamid220-kamal/heart-disease-prediction`): Clinical risk classification system using ensemble Scikit-learn algorithms.
9. **Face Recognition** (`hamid220-kamal/Face-Recognition-`): 68-point facial landmark alignment with 128D deep metric embeddings.
10. **Sentiment Analysis Tool** (`hamid220-kamal/Sentiment_Analysis_Tool`): NLP document polarity classifier with TF-IDF vectorization.
11. **AI Speech-to-Text** (`hamid220-kamal/AI-Speech-to-Text`): Audio acoustic frequency transcription engine.
12. **AI Customer Chatbot** (`hamid220-kamal/AI-Customer-Chatbot`): Multi-turn conversational routing with intent classification.
13. **Syntecxhub Expert System** (`hamid220-kamal/Syntecxhub_Expert_System`): Voice-enabled forward/backward chaining inference engine.
14. **A* Maze Solver** (`hamid220-kamal/Syntecxhub_Maze_Solver_AStar`): Heuristic pathfinding visualization.
15. **The Ultimate Python Course** (`hamid220-kamal/The-Ultimate-Python-Course`): Comprehensive curriculum repository from primitives to async architectures.
